(after speaking with [[Blade Operative Paulina|Paulina]]). }} Kill [[Justiciar Kimii]]. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details. ===Objectives=== * Gain passage to [[Riverside Province (explorable area)|Riverside Province]] and Kill [[Justiciar Kimii]] * *BONUS* Kill Justiciar Kimii in [[Hard Mode]] * See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward ===Reward=== * 5,000 [[Experience]] * 1,000 [[Gold]] * Complete the Base Objective for 15 [[War Supplies]] * Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 7 War Supplies ==Walkthrough== Despite the quest marker leading you to Riverside Province, begin from [[Sanctum Cay (outpost)|Sanctum Cay]] by speaking with [[Blade Operative Paulina]]. Once inside, it is simply a matter of making your way to the [[Temple of the Unseen]] and killing your target; As she uses [[Conviction]] and [[Armor of Sanctity]], you might consider enchantment removals and/or [[Weaken Armor]] to make killing her easier. Note that Kimii can be killed during [[Riverside Assassination]], but it's much harder to reach her with the quest active. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Wanted by the Shining Blade :''"Justiciar Kimii has been responsible for the "re-education" of countless Krytans, using her powerful Mesmer abilities to traumatize her victim's minds to the point of catatonia. She has reduced some of the greatest philosophers and intellectuals of Kryta into drooling simpletons simply because they refused to accept the White Mantle's Unseen Gods as their own. Disturbingly, Justiciar Kimii claims this mind warping process is a "cure," and that while the procedure has some unfortunate side effects, living a life without accepting the Unseen Ones as the true gods of Tyria is even worse. She was last seen in Riverside Province, searching for non-believers in need of her treatment. Queen Salma offers a reward and her gratitude to those who rid Kryta of Kimii's twisted form of therapy once and for all. Speak to Blade Operative Paulina in Sanctum Cay to have a boat sneak you into the province under cover of night."'' ;After completion of The Battle for Lion's Arch :''"Re-create this classic event from the War in Kryta! Justiciar Kimii was responsible for the "re-education" of countless Krytans during the reign of the White Mantle, using her powerful Mesmer abilities to traumatize her victim's {{sic|victims'}} minds to the point of catatonia. She reduced some of the greatest philosophers and intellectuals of Kryta to drooling simpletons simply because they refused to accept the White Mantle's Unseen Gods as their own. She was hunted down in Riverside Province by allies of Kryta who put a permanent end to Kimii's twisted mind games. Slay Justiciar Kimii once again in this completely accurate historical re-creation. Speak to Blade Operative Paulina in Sanctum Cay to have a boat sneak you into the province under cover of night."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I'll do whatever I can to help restore order to Kryta. | decline = War! What is it good for? | ask = Justicar Kimii is in Riverside Province searching for those she deems in need of re-education. Go give her a taste of her own medicine! Blade Operative Paulina in Sanctum Cay has a boat waiting to sneak you into Riverside Province. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Princess Salma :''"Thank you [Character Name], your efforts bring us one step closer to a unified nation."''
